```{r}
# ============================================================
# Figure 3
# Conceptual model of cross-system evaluation of Data Papers
# and associated research data outputs
#
# Terminology-calibrated journal version
#
# Input:
#   No external data file is required; the conceptual model is
#   drawn directly from the definitions in this script.
#
# Output:
#   output/figures/Figure_3_Conceptual_Model.png
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# 0. Restart R before running
# ============================================================
#
# RStudio:
# Session -> Restart R
#
# Then run this ENTIRE script.
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# 1. Package check
# ============================================================

required_packages <- c("here", "grid")

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Install the required packages before running this script: ",
      paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

library(here)
library(grid)


# ============================================================
# 2. Paths
# ============================================================

OUTPUT_DIR <- here("output", "figures")

if (!dir.exists(OUTPUT_DIR)) {
  dir.create(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}

if (!dir.exists(OUTPUT_DIR)) {
  stop("Failed to create output directory.")
}

PNG_FILE <- file.path(
  OUTPUT_DIR,
  "Figure_3_Conceptual_Model.png"
)


# ============================================================
# 3. Figure dimensions
# ============================================================

FIG_WIDTH_IN  <- 14
FIG_HEIGHT_IN <- 6.1


# ============================================================
# 4. Colour palette
# ============================================================

COL_TEXT       <- "#202124"
COL_MUTED      <- "#62666A"

COL_BORDER     <- "#45484B"
COL_LIGHT      <- "#B7BDC2"

COL_PANEL      <- "#F6F7F8"
COL_BOX        <- "#FFFFFF"

COL_ACCENT     <- "#365F7D"
COL_ACCENT_BG  <- "#EDF3F7"

COL_OBJECT_BG  <- "#F4F7F9"
COL_RQ4_BG     <- "#F7F7F7"
COL_RQ5_BG     <- "#FAFAFA"


# ============================================================
# 5. Helper functions
# ============================================================

draw_round_box <- function(
    x,
    y,
    width,
    height,
    fill = "white",
    border = COL_BORDER,
    lwd = 1.2,
    lty = 1,
    radius = 0.010
) {
  
  grid.roundrect(
    x = unit(x, "npc"),
    y = unit(y, "npc"),
    width = unit(width, "npc"),
    height = unit(height, "npc"),
    just = c("left", "bottom"),
    r = unit(radius, "snpc"),
    gp = gpar(
      fill = fill,
      col = border,
      lwd = lwd,
      lty = lty
    )
  )
}


draw_rq_tag <- function(
    x_center,
    y_bottom,
    label
) {
  
  TAG_W <- 0.048
  TAG_H <- 0.034
  
  grid.roundrect(
    x = unit(x_center, "npc"),
    y = unit(y_bottom, "npc"),
    width = unit(TAG_W, "npc"),
    height = unit(TAG_H, "npc"),
    just = c("centre", "bottom"),
    r = unit(0.008, "snpc"),
    gp = gpar(
      fill = COL_ACCENT_BG,
      col = NA
    )
  )
  
  grid.text(
    label,
    x = unit(x_center, "npc"),
    y = unit(y_bottom + TAG_H / 2, "npc"),
    gp = gpar(
      fontsize = 8.3,
      fontface = "bold",
      col = COL_ACCENT,
      fontfamily = "sans"
    )
  )
}


draw_dimension_box <- function(
    x,
    y,
    width,
    height,
    title,
    subtitle,
    rq = NULL,
    special = FALSE
) {
  
  BOX_FILL <- if (special) COL_OBJECT_BG else COL_BOX
  
  draw_round_box(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    fill = BOX_FILL,
    border = COL_BORDER,
    lwd = 1.25,
    radius = 0.009
  )
  
  if (!is.null(rq)) {
    
    draw_rq_tag(
      x_center = x + width / 2,
      y_bottom = y + height + 0.010,
      label = rq
    )
  }
  
  grid.text(
    title,
    x = unit(x + width / 2, "npc"),
    y = unit(y + height * 0.65, "npc"),
    gp = gpar(
      fontsize = 11.7,
      fontface = "bold",
      col = COL_TEXT,
      fontfamily = "sans",
      lineheight = 1.05
    )
  )
  
  grid.text(
    subtitle,
    x = unit(x + width / 2, "npc"),
    y = unit(y + height * 0.27, "npc"),
    gp = gpar(
      fontsize = 9.0,
      col = COL_MUTED,
      fontfamily = "sans",
      lineheight = 1.10
    )
  )
}


draw_strategy_box <- function(
    x,
    y,
    width,
    height,
    label
) {
  
  draw_round_box(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    fill = "white",
    border = COL_LIGHT,
    lwd = 0.95,
    radius = 0.006
  )
  
  grid.text(
    label,
    x = unit(x + width / 2, "npc"),
    y = unit(y + height / 2, "npc"),
    gp = gpar(
      fontsize = 8.8,
      col = COL_TEXT,
      fontfamily = "sans",
      lineheight = 1.06
    )
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 6. Main figure
# ============================================================

draw_figure3 <- function() {
  
  grid.newpage()
  
  grid.rect(
    gp = gpar(
      fill = "white",
      col = NA
    )
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # Title
  # ==========================================================
  
  grid.text(
    paste0(
      "Conceptual model of cross-system evaluation of Data Papers\n",
      "and associated research data outputs"
    ),
    x = unit(0.040, "npc"),
    y = unit(0.972, "npc"),
    just = c("left", "top"),
    gp = gpar(
      fontsize = 17.2,
      fontface = "bold",
      col = COL_TEXT,
      fontfamily = "sans",
      lineheight = 1.05
    )
  )
  
  grid.text(
    "Synthesis of the principal analytical dimensions identified across RQ1–RQ4",
    x = unit(0.040, "npc"),
    y = unit(0.866, "npc"),
    just = "left",
    gp = gpar(
      fontsize = 10.8,
      col = COL_MUTED,
      fontfamily = "sans"
    )
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # Main analytical panel
  # ==========================================================
  
  PANEL_X <- 0.020
  PANEL_Y <- 0.475
  PANEL_W <- 0.960
  PANEL_H <- 0.335
  
  draw_round_box(
    x = PANEL_X,
    y = PANEL_Y,
    width = PANEL_W,
    height = PANEL_H,
    fill = COL_PANEL,
    border = COL_BORDER,
    lwd = 1.20,
    lty = 2,
    radius = 0.013
  )
  
  grid.text(
    "Analytical dimensions of cross-system evaluation",
    x = unit(0.045, "npc"),
    y = unit(0.775, "npc"),
    just = "left",
    gp = gpar(
      fontsize = 12.4,
      fontface = "bold",
      col = COL_TEXT,
      fontfamily = "sans"
    )
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # Conceptual ordering
  # ==========================================================
  
  grid.lines(
    x = unit(c(0.073, 0.950), "npc"),
    y = unit(c(0.615, 0.615), "npc"),
    arrow = arrow(
      type = "closed",
      length = unit(0.12, "inches")
    ),
    gp = gpar(
      col = COL_ACCENT,
      lwd = 3.1,
      lineend = "butt"
    )
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # Six analytical dimensions
  # ==========================================================
  
  BOX_Y <- 0.535
  BOX_W <- 0.135
  BOX_H <- 0.180
  
  BOX_X <- c(
    0.045,
    0.200,
    0.355,
    0.510,
    0.665,
    0.820
  )
  
  
  # Evaluation objects
  draw_dimension_box(
    x = BOX_X[1],
    y = BOX_Y,
    width = BOX_W,
    height = BOX_H,
    title =
      "Evaluation\nobjects",
    subtitle =
      "Data Paper\nAssociated dataset\nReuse-related publication",
    rq = NULL,
    special = TRUE
  )
  
  
  # RQ1
  draw_dimension_box(
    x = BOX_X[2],
    y = BOX_Y,
    width = BOX_W,
    height = BOX_H,
    title =
      "Coverage and\nclassification",
    subtitle =
      "Indexing scope\nDocument-type classification\nRepresentation",
    rq =
      "RQ1"
  )
  
  
  # RQ2: metadata representation, discoverability, and linkage
  draw_dimension_box(
    x = BOX_X[3],
    y = BOX_Y,
    width = BOX_W,
    height = BOX_H,
    title =
      "Metadata and\nlinkage",
    subtitle =
      "Persistent identifiers\nContextual metadata\nPublication–data relations",
    rq =
      "RQ2"
  )
  
  
  # RQ3: citation capture, entity resolution, and counting
  draw_dimension_box(
    x = BOX_X[4],
    y = BOX_Y,
    width = BOX_W,
    height = BOX_H,
    title =
      "Citation capture and\nentity resolution",
    subtitle =
      "Formal/informal references\nIdentifier resolution\nDeduplication",
    rq =
      "RQ3"
  )
  
  
  # RQ3: temporal and normalization conditions affecting measurement
  draw_dimension_box(
    x = BOX_X[5],
    y = BOX_Y,
    width = BOX_W,
    height = BOX_H,
    title =
      "Temporal and\nnormalization factors",
    subtitle =
      "Citation window\nIndexing lag\nNormalization",
    rq =
      "RQ3"
  )
  
  
  # Final measures
  draw_dimension_box(
    x = BOX_X[6],
    y = BOX_Y,
    width = BOX_W,
    height = BOX_H,
    title =
      "Evaluation\nmeasures",
    subtitle =
      "Publication citations\nDataset citations\nEvidence of reuse",
    rq = NULL
  )
  
  
  grid.text(
    "Conceptual ordering",
    x = unit(0.500, "npc"),
    y = unit(0.492, "npc"),
    gp = gpar(
      fontsize = 8.2,
      fontface = "italic",
      col = COL_MUTED,
      fontfamily = "sans"
    )
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # RQ4
  # ==========================================================
  
  RQ4_X <- 0.020
  RQ4_Y <- 0.125
  RQ4_W <- 0.742
  RQ4_H <- 0.285
  
  draw_round_box(
    x = RQ4_X,
    y = RQ4_Y,
    width = RQ4_W,
    height = RQ4_H,
    fill = COL_RQ4_BG,
    border = COL_BORDER,
    lwd = 1.15,
    radius = 0.012
  )
  
  grid.text(
    "Methodological responses and corrective strategies — RQ4",
    x = unit(RQ4_X + 0.025, "npc"),
    y = unit(RQ4_Y + RQ4_H - 0.045, "npc"),
    just = "left",
    gp = gpar(
      fontsize = 12.4,
      fontface = "bold",
      col = COL_TEXT,
      fontfamily = "sans"
    )
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # RQ4 strategies
  # ==========================================================
  
  STRATEGY_W <- 0.215
  STRATEGY_H <- 0.064
  
  SX1 <- 0.045
  SX2 <- 0.282
  SX3 <- 0.519
  
  SY_TOP    <- 0.235
  SY_BOTTOM <- 0.155
  
  
  draw_strategy_box(
    x = SX1,
    y = SY_TOP,
    width = STRATEGY_W,
    height = STRATEGY_H,
    label =
      "Metadata standardization\nand enrichment"
  )
  
  draw_strategy_box(
    x = SX2,
    y = SY_TOP,
    width = STRATEGY_W,
    height = STRATEGY_H,
    label =
      "Structured linkage, graph integration,\nand interoperability"
  )
  
  draw_strategy_box(
    x = SX3,
    y = SY_TOP,
    width = STRATEGY_W,
    height = STRATEGY_H,
    label =
      "Automated citation/reference detection,\ntracking, and entity resolution"
  )
  
  draw_strategy_box(
    x = SX1,
    y = SY_BOTTOM,
    width = STRATEGY_W,
    height = STRATEGY_H,
    label =
      "Citation standardization\nand attribution practices"
  )
  
  draw_strategy_box(
    x = SX2,
    y = SY_BOTTOM,
    width = STRATEGY_W,
    height = STRATEGY_H,
    label =
      "Credit allocation, metric normalization,\nand responsible assessment"
  )
  
  draw_strategy_box(
    x = SX3,
    y = SY_BOTTOM,
    width = STRATEGY_W,
    height = STRATEGY_H,
    label =
      "Data Paper documentation, publication,\nand peer-review workflow reform"
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # RQ5
  # ==========================================================
  
  RQ5_X <- 0.795
  RQ5_Y <- 0.125
  RQ5_W <- 0.185
  RQ5_H <- 0.285
  
  draw_round_box(
    x = RQ5_X,
    y = RQ5_Y,
    width = RQ5_W,
    height = RQ5_H,
    fill = COL_RQ5_BG,
    border = COL_ACCENT,
    lwd = 1.25,
    lty = 2,
    radius = 0.012
  )
  
  
  grid.text(
    "Synthesis of RQ1–RQ4",
    x = unit(RQ5_X + RQ5_W / 2, "npc"),
    y = unit(RQ5_Y + RQ5_H * 0.865, "npc"),
    gp = gpar(
      fontsize = 8.1,
      fontface = "bold",
      col = COL_ACCENT,
      fontfamily = "sans"
    )
  )
  
  
  grid.text(
    "RQ5",
    x = unit(RQ5_X + RQ5_W / 2, "npc"),
    y = unit(RQ5_Y + RQ5_H * 0.715, "npc"),
    gp = gpar(
      fontsize = 10.8,
      fontface = "bold",
      col = COL_ACCENT,
      fontfamily = "sans"
    )
  )
  
  
  grid.text(
    "Evidence gaps and\nfuture priorities",
    x = unit(RQ5_X + RQ5_W / 2, "npc"),
    y = unit(RQ5_Y + RQ5_H * 0.49, "npc"),
    gp = gpar(
      fontsize = 11.5,
      fontface = "bold",
      col = COL_TEXT,
      fontfamily = "sans",
      lineheight = 1.06
    )
  )
  
  
  grid.text(
    paste0(
      "Diagnostic findings\n",
      "Directness and applicability of evidence\n",
      "Methodological maturity\n",
      "Reported limitations and future directions"
    ),
    x = unit(RQ5_X + RQ5_W / 2, "npc"),
    y = unit(RQ5_Y + RQ5_H * 0.225, "npc"),
    gp = gpar(
      fontsize = 7.8,
      col = COL_MUTED,
      fontfamily = "sans",
      lineheight = 1.08
    )
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 7. Export PNG
# ============================================================

png(
  filename = PNG_FILE,
  width = FIG_WIDTH_IN,
  height = FIG_HEIGHT_IN,
  units = "in",
  res = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

draw_figure3()

dev.off()


# ============================================================
# 8. Validation
# ============================================================

if (!file.exists(PNG_FILE)) {
  stop("PNG export failed.")
}

PNG_SIZE <- file.info(PNG_FILE)$size

if (is.na(PNG_SIZE) || PNG_SIZE <= 0) {
  stop("PNG exists but appears empty.")
}

cat("\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
cat("Figure 3 exported successfully\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

cat("PNG:\n", PNG_FILE, "\n\n")

cat("PASS: Figure 3 generated successfully.\n")


# ============================================================
# 9. Suggested caption
# ============================================================

CAPTION <- paste0(
  "Figure 3. Conceptual model of cross-system evaluation of Data Papers ",
  "and associated research data outputs. The model synthesizes the principal ",
  "analytical dimensions identified across RQ1–RQ4, including evaluation objects, ",
  "coverage and classification, metadata and linkage, citation capture and entity ",
  "resolution, temporal and normalization factors, and the resulting evaluation ",
  "measures. Methodological responses identified under RQ4 address limitations ",
  "across these dimensions. RQ5 draws on the combined findings of RQ1–RQ4, ",
  "the directness and applicability of the available evidence, methodological ",
  "maturity, and limitations and future directions reported in the included studies. ",
  "The horizontal ordering is analytical and should not be interpreted as a ",
  "validated causal pathway."
)

cat("\nSuggested caption:\n\n")
cat(CAPTION)
cat("\n")
```
